jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced and motivated Software Development Engineer (SDE-2) to design, build, and operate scalable software systems that power capacity management decisions across Amazon's outbound fulfillment network in PACMAN team under SCOT organization. In this role, you will be responsible for developing robust, production-grade services that surface capacity utilization trends, detect risk patterns in real time. The Amazon Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) team works on some of the world's most complex supply chain challenges, at Amazon scale. Within SCOT, the Fulfillment Optimization (FO) organization owns products and services that plan and execute orders for the outbound network worldwide — from designing network topology to providing accurate customer promises and selecting optimal fulfillment paths. What we're looking for: - Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, and system design. - Experience with or passion for: Algorithms, optimizations, and generative AI. - Ability to break down ambiguous, complex problems into elegant, shippable solutions - Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where you own your systems end-to-end - Excellent communication skills and a track record of raising the engineering bar on your team Key job responsibilities - Design and implement software solutions across major portions of your team's systems, balancing new feature development with refactoring and operational improvements to maintain long-term code health. - Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to understand business requirements and deliver the right solutions, ensuring alignment between customer needs and technical direction. - Participate actively in the full software development lifecycle, including system design, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production operations, while applying sound judgment on data structures, algorithms, and architectural trade-offs. - Mentor and coach other engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, producing clear documentation so that your software can be maintained and extended by those unfamiliar with the codebase. - Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, continuously improving your team's processes, reliability, and overall software quality. A day in the life - Collaborate with Engineering, Science, and Product teams to design and implement new capacity tracking features — owning the technical architecture from high-level design through deployment, testing and including data pipeline construction for capacity ingestion and consumption. - Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs that power the end-to-end lifecycle of capacity tracking: from initial configuration by resource owners, through real-time consumption tracking, to detection and risk notification — ensuring low latency, high availability, and data accuracy. - Own and improve systems that detect discrepancies between expected and actual capacity utilization across outbound resources (sort centers, delivery stations, fulfillment centers) — building automated alerting, self-healing mechanisms, and diagnostic tooling to surface and resolve mismatches proactively using generative AI. - Partner with capacity resource owners and FO decision-system teams to translate new data requirements and into technical specifications, leading design reviews and driving implementation across the service stack. - Investigate and resolve production issues — by performing root-cause analysis, authoring corrections of errors (COEs), and driving operational improvements to prevent recurrence. - Ensure peak event readiness (Prime Day, holiday season) by conducting performance and load testing, identifying and mitigating system bottlenecks, hardening capacity data services for throughput spikes, and participating in operational readiness reviews (ORRs) to guarantee timely and accurate risk signals at scale. About the team The PACMAN (Persistence And Capacity Management) team serves as the centralized authority for capacity availability across all of Amazon's physical outbound resources. Accurate, granular, and real-time capacity tracking is foundational for FO planning and execution systems to effectively utilize first and third party resources. From generating reliable network flow plans to providing accurate customer promises on the website and selecting optimal fulfillment paths for customer shipments, capacity information is a critical input at every step of fulfillment decision making.

jobs.description: EC2 Networking is at an exciting inflection point as we shape the next generation of cloud networking. To deliver on our ambitious roadmap, we are growing our team and looking for talented engineers to join us. You will be part of the team that owns the software-defined networking dataplane stack powering EC2 across workloads such as machine learning, high-performance computing, cloud gaming, healthcare, fintech, and video streaming. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide by delivering secure, scalable, highly available, and high-performance networking at massive scale. In this role, you will own the design, implementation, testing, and delivery of networking capabilities across multiple areas. This includes performance and availability improvements for machine learning and high-performance workloads running on accelerated EC2 platforms, as well as new high-performance networking interfaces and instance capabilities for edge computing. You will solve complex systems challenges where performance, scale, availability, and correctness are all critical, while helping extend EC2 networking to support new workload types and deployment environments. 회사 소개
CPLB(Coupang Private Label Brands)는 고품질의 상품을 경쟁력 있는 가격에 제공함으로써 고객에게 최대 가치를 전달하고자 노력하는 조직입니다. 신선 식품 브랜드 곰곰, 가정 및 반려동물 용품 브랜드 탐사, 건강 및 미용 제품 브랜드 비타할로, 라이프 및 홈 브랜드 코멧을 포함한 프라이빗 브랜드의 상품은 고객들에게 가장 저렴한 가격과 최고의 서비스로 훌륭한 제품을 선택할 수 있는 상품 셀렉션을 제공합니다. CPLB 는 고객을 위한 가격, 서비스 및 선택 사이의 가장 큰 균형을 깨기 위한 우리의 사명의 모범 사례입니다. 또한 CPLB 는 고객 및 중소기업과 함께 더 큰 혜택을 공유하기 위해 양질의 중소기업 파트너와 계속 협력할 것입니다.
CPLB 는 다양한 배경을 가진 전문가들로 구성된 역동적인 팀이며, Brand Managment, Instock Management, Technical Services, Program Management, 디자인, 품질 및 컴플라이언스, 재무 및 마케팅이 포함됩니다.
우리는 전문 지식을 활용하여 시장 동향과 통찰력을 따라 고객을 위한 관련 제품을 개발합니다. 우리는 재고 관리를 최적화하고 제품을 경쟁력 있는 가격으로 항상 사용할 수 있도록 하기 위해 가장 효율적인 공급망을 설계하기 위해 노력합니다. 우리는 고객을 위해 더 많은 제품을 개발하는 반면 기술과 자동화 시스템을 사용하여 내부 프로세스와 비즈니스 효율성을 지속적으로 향상시킵니다. 우리 팀은 우리의 모든 제품과 프로세스가 규제 요구 사항을 준수하도록 보장합니다.
CPLB 에서는 자신만의 전문성을 살려 고객이 사랑하는 브랜드를 만들 수 있는 기회를 찾을 수 있습니다. 더 다양한 쿠팡의 자체 상품 셀렉션을 함께 만들어 가고 싶다면 CPLB 와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
CPLB PMO Ops - RG 팀은 쿠팡 로켓그로스(Rocket Growth) 상품이 물류센터(FC) 보관 규정, 법적 및 미디어 규제 리스크를 완화할 수 있도록 쿠팡 정책을 운용하고 사전/사후 점검을 수행하는 오퍼레이션 팀입니다. 위험물, 유해물, 고압가스, 냉장/냉동, 화약류, 의료기기 등 FC 보관 및 유통 시 법적 리스크가 있는 상품군을 정밀하게 판별하고 모니터링하여, 안전하고 지속 가능한 셀러 비즈니스 생태계를 구축하는 핵심 게이트키퍼(Gatekeeper) 역할을 합니다.
업무 내용
• 팀 리더십 및 오퍼레이션 총괄 관리
- PMO Ops - RG 팀의 오퍼레이션 목표(KPI/SLA) 수립 및 리소스 최적화
- 사전/사후 상품 규제 검토 프로세스의 효율화 및 표준운용절차(SOP) 고도화
- 팀원역량강화, 코칭, 성과관리 및 데이터기반의 생산성 관리
• 고위험 카테고리 규제 검토 및 리스크 제어
- 위험물(DG), 유해물(TG), 고압가스, 냉장/냉동, 화약류, 의료기기 등 리스크 카테고리 상품의 법적 보관 기준 및 분류 체계 운용
- 사전/사후 점검 데이터 분석을 통한 예방책 수립
• 유관 부서 협업 및 정책

- 셀러 온보딩 가이드 개선 및 컴플라이언스 이슈 발생 시 Cross-functional 이슈 솔루션 도출
자격

• 문제 해결 능력: 대규모 상품 데이터를 기반으로 리스크 요인을 발굴하고 프로세스를 개선해 본 경험

• 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고사항

3. 위 2 항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangpl.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
4. 당사는 위 2 항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
5. 단, 위 1 항 내지 4 항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.description: About Maintenance at Amazon Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. As a
Revenue Accounting Manager
,
you’ll be in charge of certain areas of the game revenue accounting at Riot Games. This involves critical accounting player life estimates, big data transaction reconciliation and automation for micropayments, devising structure to address controls and risks including for accounts receivable, and thoughtfully developing the technical accounting for emerging revenue issues. To be successful, you’ll need to be flexible working at both a review level and a hands-on detailed level. You will drive projects forward and collaborate with other teams including Finance, Game teams, Payments, Legal, Data, and accounting teams in our global offices.
This position reports to the Accounting Director and will play a key leadership role in the overall Accounting organization around change management, improving processes and controls, scaling accounting, company infrastructure and operations.
Responsibilities:
Deeply understand Riot’s statistical player life estimate calculation and work with a data analyst to maintain it. This includes doing analysis to explain changes, working on audit deliverables, and understanding how this estimate would apply to new products.
Reconcile large sales datasets with engineering team across the order to cash process. This data would include information from international payment processors with unique fees, FX, and taxes.
Further develop processes and automation with the engineering team to increase efficiency and scope of the large data reconciliation noted above. This includes project management, understanding system data flows, and cross team collaboration.
Research and formalize technical accounting including Principal vs Agent, Point in Time vs Over Time, Costs to obtain a contract, and Consideration payable to a customer.
Review draft contracts to ensure smooth technical accounting.
Build out approaches and systems to address key risks such as receivables collectability and chargebacks monitoring.
Project manage and oversee certain day to day, period end close, and audit related activities
Implement improved approaches to internal revenue data and systems. This may include implementing a more sophisticated revenue system and the related processes
Mentor team staff
Manage relationships with external auditors to ensure timely completion of annual audits and reviews
Required Qualifications:
A bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. Big 4 experience and a CPA designation is required.
6+ years of progressive experience with at least 3 years in a leadership role in a fast paced environment. Multinational experience is required.
Project manage key areas with multiple groups. Organize and prioritize effectively and meet deadlines while maintaining quality.
Analytical, interested in deeply understanding areas, consider why an approach is better than 1-2 alternatives.
Some statistical experience, ideally in relation to critical accounting estimates.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition in a technology/entertainment company
Comfortable working with big data processes and engineer / analysts for high volume revenue transactions.
Strong leader in training and developing high-performing individuals with a clear commitment to the development and engagement of the team. Effectively listen and demonstrate an effective, collaborative approach.
Desired Qualifications:
Operational experience including global high volume credit card transactions and B2B transactions.
Experience with gaming industry player life statistical estimates or similar.
Solid experience with one or more financial ERP systems, preferably Oracle
For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!
Our Perks:
Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our
benefits pages
for more information.
At Riot Games, we
put players first
. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.
